entities.name: Gravelighter
entities.description: A territorial kami of forgotten clearings in Jukai Forest who appears to those whose lives are ending.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who protected Eiko and Himoto in his escape through Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister, a kami diplomat who asked Gravelighter for safe passage.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Friend travelling with Kaito and Eiko.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Tanuki kami whom Kaito was protecting; its light calmed Gravelighter.

events.summary: Kaito, Eiko and Tameshi meet Gravelighter, who bursts from a river, in Jukai Forest.
events.quote: This kami, known for her territorial nature, burst forth from a river

events.summary: Eiko introduces herself as a kami diplomat and requests safe passage.
events.quote: Eiko attempted to communicate, introducing herself as a kami diplomat and requesting safe passage

events.summary: Kaito intervenes to protect Eiko, drawing Gravelighter's ire.
events.quote: Kaito intervened to protect Eiko, drawing Gravelighter's ire

events.summary: Himoto leaps at Gravelighter emitting a powerful light, calming her; she retreats into the river and the party continues safely.
events.quote: ultimately retreated into the river, allowing Kaito and his companions to continue their journey safely

relations.quote: the tanuki kami Himoto , whom Kaito was protecting
It is a territorial spirit that lives in the Jukai Forest.
